clips.title: The story
paras: As the Nightbane pack tightens its grip on Duskwood, Calor directs adventurers to strike against their deadliest ranks. Taking the fight directly to their southern dens and mines, defenders push back the feral threat encroaching on Darkshire.

The worgen infestation haunting Duskwood is far from mindless chaos. Having carved out territory in the dark expanse south of Darkshire, the beasts known as the Nightbane have begun establishing fortified camps. Calor watches their bonfires flicker in the distance with growing dread, noting that the creatures have occupied deep caves and abandoned mining shafts. Among them, the Vile Fangs and Tainted Ones represent the most vicious breeds, displaying ferocious savagery and a tenacity that threatens to overwhelm the town's perimeter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.
Of the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.
From far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Intimidating beasts aren't they? But have no fear, friend, those who stand for the Light will never fall!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly an adventurer to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
